title: New Markdown sites
content:
New and notable Markdown sites.

  • John Evdemon's blog, as viewed in BonBon. Runs on Known, with a small script that serves each post as Markdown.
  • Joseph Fieber's site, as viewed in BonBon. Converted from WordPress. Written in Obsidian, served by Grav.
  • R. S. Doiel's blog, as viewed in BonBon. Built with his own antennaApp, hosted on GitHub Pages.

We learned about these sites in the Issues section of the BonBon repo. If you do something nice with Markdown sites, send us a link, and be sure to use the demo app to test your sites.
